_written: 2026-10-13, BEFORE any OKX/Deribit return was computed (download still running).
goal (user): steadier monthly returns / consistent payouts at Crypto Fund Trader (Bybit route), without overfitting; target share of positive months >= 65% with net Sharpe > 1.3 and CAGR > 15% at a CFT-feasible risk (worst intraday day > -4%)

universe (point-in-time, daily): coins with >= 60 days of OKX history and trailing-30d median daily quote volume >= $20m; BTC/ETH always in

hypotheses (each one trial; parameters f.H1_XS_REVERSAL_1D: market-neutral: rank coins by previous-day return; long bottom quintile, short top quintile, equal weight, dollar-neutral, rebalanced daily
hypotheses (each one trial; parameters f.H2_XS_REVERSAL_3D: same with 3-day return, rebalanced daily (1/3 of book per day, overlapping)
hypotheses (each one trial; parameters f.H3_XS_MOMENTUM_28D: market-neutral: long top quintile / short bottom quintile by 28-day return skipping the last day, weekly rebalance (replication of the classic; gen16/18 on Coin Metrics rejected it)
hypotheses (each one trial; parameters f.H4_XS_TREND_E2: market-neutral: long top quintile / short bottom quintile by the E2 signal (unclipped), daily
hypotheses (each one trial; parameters f.H5_BTCETH_FUNDING_CONTRARIAN: BTC/ETH: 7d mean Deribit funding z-score (365d) > +1.5 -> short 1 unit, < -1.5 -> long 1 unit, else flat; vol-targeted
hypotheses (each one trial; parameters f.H6_HOURLY_SHOCK_REVERSAL: BTC/ETH: after an hourly return < -3 x hourly sigma(30d), buy at next hour open, hold 12 hours (and symmetric short after > +3 sigma); vol-targeted

sizing: each strategy scaled to 10% annual vol on DEV
acceptance per hypothesis: net Sharpe >= 0.8 DEV, >= 0.5 VAL, >= 0.5 TEST, 2x-cost TEST >= 0.3, Holm-adjusted bootstrap p < 0.05 over the 6 hypotheses (2020-2026), and replication: same sign and Sharpe >= 0.3 on the half of the universe NOT containing the top-20 by volume
combination (only accepted sleeves + C*: equal-risk blend; report share of positive months, worst month, monthly Sharpe, worst intraday day (real hourly lows), CFT 1-Phase/2-Phase pass rates and payout-month frequency
